MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Physiology? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Physiology.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Physiology.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Physiology.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Physiology.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvesting and Post-Harvest Handling 2.3 Fish Value Addition ? (1 mark)

   D. Only water vapour

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)

   D. 100 °C

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

19. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

   B. Producers
